# All or nothing: distributed transactions in Azure Cosmos DB

## What Changed

Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL can now commit writes across partition keys, containers, and databases as one atomic unit. Distributed transactions are currently in public preview. Every operation commits, or none of them do. Previously, applications that needed atomic operations across multiple logical partitions often relied on application-managed patterns such as sagas and compensating transactions. […]

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A preview can inform roadmap and technical validation, but is not a production commitment.
